purpose: Transparent audit of the original 19 commissions in The Kakistocrat editorial blueprint. A published anchor does not by itself complete the quantitative follow-up.

taxonomy.published-anchor: A directly relevant article exists, but its supporting visual or deeper comparison may still be outstanding.
taxonomy.partial: Substantial related coverage exists, but the precise original research question has not been fully answered.
taxonomy.evidence-gate: Requires new matched or independently verified data before a defensible new investigation.
taxonomy.synthesis-pending: Editorial synthesis reserved until constituent evidence can sustain comparisons.

commissions.title: What America's first tariff schedule meant for Indian exporters
commissions.next_evidence: Product-by-product customs costs under the original Annex I, MFN rates and exclusions. Verify any discrepancy in initial India and US rate statements.

commissions.title: Import receipts masked weaker domestic GST revenue
commissions.next_evidence: Add a consistent gross-to-net GST revenue bridge with domestic, import, refunds and matching release vintages.

commissions.title: Who kept the savings from India's GST rate cuts?
commissions.next_evidence: Obtain comparable transaction/shelf prices by SKU; calculate matched product pass-through with appropriate control products; CPI alone cannot establish incidence.

commissions.title: What the India-US trade framework actually offered exporters
commissions.next_evidence: Continue tracking legally effective product-specific terms and changes in instruments after court rulings.

commissions.title: The US textile tariff proposal makes supplier traceability matter
commissions.next_evidence: Build product-line exposure to the June proposal and the July final action; verify actual exemptions and quota operation.

commissions.title: When India rationed commercial LPG, who lost supply first?
commissions.next_evidence: Match official commercial allocations with physical uplift and delivered volumes, by channel and period, before claiming customer shortfalls.

commissions.title: Fertiliser subsidies protected prices. Did they protect access?
commissions.next_evidence: Use matched nutrient rates, feedstock costs, stocks and retail availability to estimate support and actual access.

commissions.title: What paid India's oil bill when dollar demand rose?
commissions.next_evidence: Reconcile oil imports, services credits, remittances, financial account and reserves on a common frequency; distinguish OMC market-liquidity support.

commissions.title: What India's 2026 monsoon meant for prices and farm incomes
commissions.next_evidence: Build district-matched rainfall, sowing, market arrival and two crop prices; use seasonal baselines and source harmonisation.

commissions.title: Which state budgets turned fiscal room into investment?
commissions.next_evidence: Match state BE, RE and actual capex; separate borrowing, central loans, grants and project completion.

commissions.title: How much of the RBI's easing reached borrowers?
commissions.next_evidence: Extend the reproducible rate notebook to product/bank-type pairs and loan-mix effects.

commissions.title: Why food and fuel inflation felt different across households
commissions.next_evidence: Secure real, documented expenditure profiles and compatible item/group inflation; avoid invented household CPI rates.

commissions.title: What drove 7.8% growth and how would private investment follow?
commissions.next_evidence: Build vintage-consistent expenditure contribution panel and matched private capex / commissioning evidence.

commissions.title: India's UK, EU and New Zealand deals are at different legal stages
commissions.next_evidence: Crosswalk signed, concluded and in-force texts, rules of origin, product quotas and legal entry dates.

commissions.title: Can a small exporter afford to claim a UK tariff preference?
commissions.next_evidence: Combine audited shipment-level preference with actual document/verification costs and utilisation, not only illustrative assumptions.

commissions.title: Did India's jobs improvement translate into better work?
commissions.next_evidence: Match PLFS participation, employment status, hours and compatible earnings, with gender/location breakdown and measurement limits.

commissions.title: When does an industrial subsidy buy working capacity?
commissions.next_evidence: Follow three schemes from approval to funding to commissioned and utilised capacity, without assuming all awards yield operating assets.

commissions.title: What shaped India's economy in 2025-26?
commissions.next_evidence: The 3,300+ word annual flagship was published 14 November 2026 and links eight series and a five-outcome ledger. Outstanding work: matched real-wage measures, product-level GST incidence, project-level private-capex outcomes and liability maturity for exceptional external financing. Do not present the article as completed causal attribution.

commissions.title: What the final US forced-labour action changed for textiles
commissions.next_evidence: Create matched HS-line landed-cost comparisons; verify announced versus operational textile TRQ treatment for competitor countries.
